# Quality Indicator Result

This folder contains the aggregated national results for specific healthcare quality indicators in Denmark. It details the performance percentages and incidence rates, along with 95% confidence intervals, for indicators such as Indikator 1 through Indikator 15 across various reporting periods. The data primarily draws from the 2025 AFDK annual report to track national compliance and clinical outcomes.

## Pages

- [[quality-indicator-result|Quality Indicator Result]] — National performance data and incidence rates for specific Danish healthcare quality indicators, including confidence intervals and reporting periods
